ClientSession.description: Authenticated identity, not a credential or permission grant.
ClientSession.title: ClientSession

last_progress_at.description: Last verified dispatcher visit, not evidence of objective completion.
last_progress_at.title: Last Progress At

runs.description: Up to 40 most recent accessible conversation runs; not a complete history.
runs.title: Runs

ExplanationReadback.description: Typed retained prose only, never raw reasoning or transport.
ExplanationReadback.title: ExplanationReadback

MessageDocument.description: Immutable admission snapshot; the original remains in private storage.
MessageDocument.title: MessageDocument

RetainedLocalResult.description: Read-only journal projection, not a published/accepted product.
RetainedLocalResult.title: RetainedLocalResult

failure_reason.description: Last actionable dispatcher denial, not a terminal outcome or permission to retry.
failure_reason.title: Failure Reason

next_action.description: Fixed safe guidance; never exception or provider text.
next_action.title: Next Action

value.description: Exact signed i64 return as a decimal string; never parse as a JSON number.
value.title: Value

WorkAreaIdentification.description: Bounded descriptive output, never authority or a second work ledger.
WorkAreaIdentification.title: WorkAreaIdentification

info.description: Isolated PostgreSQL-backed fixture/scenario service. Not a live provider runtime. Bearer is a private local human credential; no model-callable approval surface.
info.title: Workagent local domain baseline
